description: Shows the latest headline row reported by each publisher in the MORVS Government Data Demand Register, side by side with each figure's label. The figures are each publisher's own counts for its own period and scope. Companies count differently; never add or rank their figures across companies. A missing figure means not reported, not zero. National-security figures remain bands. Aggregate counts cannot show whether any person's data was requested. Optionally restrict to one sector.

sector.description: Optional sector: big_tech, platform, ai, carrier, cameras_devices or official. Publisher counts have different scopes; never add or rank them.

name: data_demand_compare
title: Compare Data Demand Headlines
